query: avg_over_time(kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true"}[24h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1) < 0.99
why: Share of the last 24h a currently Running pod was Ready (below 0.99 only). Time it was out of the endpoints due to readiness failures. Pairs with Unhealthy events
